g.text: Buffer releases the box; the conveyor brings it to the pick stop
Retry vision twice; if still no, send it to the

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #c26a00

g.text: Gripper descends onto the top face; seal at full vacuum (80 kPa)
Re-seat up to 2 times; if still no,

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #c26a00
font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1d232b

g.text: Lift 8 cm and hold still; the wrist F/T sensor weighs the box
Flag the mismatch; continue with the

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #c26a00

g.text: Set the box back down and reject it

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #c26a00

g.text: Set vacuum: F = margin × SF × m × (g + a / 0.5)
P = F ÷ 78.5 cm², limited to 8–80 kPa

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1d232b

g.text: Carry to the pallet; move time grows with weight and distance

g.text: Lower to 3 cm above the spot; vision measures the box
and the arm corrects its position (2 passes)

text.style: font-size: 7.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1d232b

g.text: Release 2 mm above the resting place; retract
